# Gelatine Sculpt (gelatinesculpt.onrender.com)

> gelatinesculpt.onrender.com is an independent reader information site about Gelatine Sculpt, a liquid dietary supplement. It is not the manufacturer or seller and does not take orders.

## Product facts (from the seller's page and supplied bottle photos)
- Form: liquid drops in a dropper bottle; the bottle says it helps maintain healthy digestion and nutrient absorption and supports healthy metabolism; directions described by the seller as one dropper each morning
- Named ingredients: green tea extract, gelatine, turmeric, berberine; amounts are on the Supplement Facts panel
- Gelatine is animal-derived, so the product is not plant-based
- Packs: 2 bottles $79 each ($158 plus a small shipping fee), 4 bottles $55 each ($220, free shipping), 8 bottles $37 each ($294, free shipping); seller lists 60, 120 and 180 day supplies; free digital guides listed with the 4 and 8 bottle packs
- 60-day refund promise: email support with your order number; refund to the original payment method in 3 to 5 business days; no return of the bottle needed
- Not a treatment for any disease and not a proven weight loss product; berberine can interact with many medicines including diabetes medicine
